610:t_1:3.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

610:t_1:4.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Captain, I'm indebted to you for a great many things.」

610:t_1:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「The pleasure was mine. Learning how $$ジオン$$ fights was a valuable experience.」

610:t_1:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Not that there will be any more fighting between the Federation and $$ジオン$$ from here on...」

610:t_1:7.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'll be aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ assisting the princesses and the others, so I'm asking you to look after $$マリーダ$$.」

610:t_1:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ is fired up over there. I hear he has declared that he'll protect her himself.」

610:t_1:9.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「So that ensign has toughened up too...」

610:t_1:10.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Then again, a pampered young master who gets that carried away by his own assumptions will probably end up being looked after by $$マリーダ$$ instead.」

610:t_1:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「When all of this is over, let's have a drink.」

610:t_1:14.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Agreed. I'll be praying for your good fortune in battle.」

610:t_1:15.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Captain, I'm indebted to you for a great many things.」

610:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「The pleasure was mine. Learning how $$ジオン$$ fights was a valuable experience.」

610:t_1:17.en:
$$オットー$$
「Not that there will be any more fighting between the Federation and $$ジオン$$ from here on...」

610:t_1:18.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'll be aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ on duty, assisting the princesses and the others.」

610:t_1:19.en:
$$オットー$$
「Leave the decisive battle with the Empire to us.」

610:t_1:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「When all of this is over, let's have a drink.」

610:t_1:22.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Agreed. I'll be praying for your good fortune in battle.」

610:t_1:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Well then, I'm off, $$オードリー$$.」

610:t_1:24.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I'll be in space with Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$ and the others, handling negotiations with the remnants of $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

610:t_1:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「It would be fine for me or $$ハマーン$$ to stay behind, you know, $$ミネバ$$?」

610:t_1:26.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「There is no need to worry, $$シャア$$. The name of $$ジオン$$ may soon disappear, but until then I will fulfill my duty as a blood heir of the $$ザビ家$$.」

610:t_1:27.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ジオン$$ and the $$ザビ家$$ will both vanish... And yet humanity moves forward.」

610:t_1:28.en:
$$バナージ$$
「For that very reason, we have to liberate this world from the $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_1:29.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...My one and only wish... You'll grant it, won't you, $$バナージ$$?」

610:t_1:30.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll definitely come back to you... I promise, $$オードリー$$.」

610:t_1:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Two people swearing to meet again... What a touching scene...」

610:t_1:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「Too soft. At that level, $$バナージ$$ might not make it through the battles ahead...」

610:t_1:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「To raise his morale even more, I need to teach him what a promise made at a reunion really is...」

610:t_1:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Make up your mind already - are you being romantic or just tactless!」

610:t_1:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's been a while since I took a hit from $$千鳥$$'s paper fan.」

610:t_1:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I made it in my spare time from my Life Support Team duties. I figured something like this might come up.」

610:t_1:37.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You're completely back to form now, $$カナメ$$.」

610:t_1:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah. Though all that precious knowledge I had as a $$ウィスパード$$ got wiped out completely.」

610:t_1:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Speaking of which... how about you, $$テッサ$$?」

610:t_1:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「From now on, no new Black Technology will be whispered to anyone, but in my case, I have the knowledge I've had since childhood.」

610:t_1:41.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So if I apply it, I think I can make my way to some extent as an engineer.」

610:t_1:42.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Being a captain and an engineer both... you're going to stay busy for a while yet, $$テッサ$$.」

610:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't possibly do both, so while everyone is on operations in the atmosphere, I'll be guarding the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

610:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There's also something I'd like to look into a little, using the facilities there.」

610:t_1:45.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then... we're parting for a little while.」

610:t_1:46.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Both you and $$相良$$ will promise me we'll meet again, won't you?」

610:t_1:48.en:
$$かなめ$$
「We'll definitely meet again, $$テッサ$$.」

610:t_1:50.en:
$$テッサ$$
(While everyone is liberating the Earth, I'll analyze the idea $$カナメ$$ came up with while being held captive, and what $$レナード$$ left behind...)

610:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
(That power, and the data $$ノリコ$$ gave me... They will become the power to open up humanity's future...)

610:t_1:55.en: ～ $$セントラル・ベース$$, Command Room ～

610:t_1:56.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...So this Earth too has been under the $$サイデリアル$$'s management since it first advanced into space.」

610:t_1:57.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That's hardly surprising. There are more than 20 such planets in this galaxy alone.」

610:t_1:58.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But even though we exercise direct rule, is it not the first time in history that the $$サイデリアル$$'s management of evolution has been made public?」

610:t_1:59.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「True... That one matter alone has always been kept secret from the species under management.」

610:t_1:60.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「And, astonishingly, even after hearing this truth, the Earthlings are apparently raising their morale.」

610:t_1:61.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So it seems... With the uprising of the Resistance and the $$連邦軍$$, the front lines everywhere are starting to come apart at the seams.」

610:t_1:62.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I never thought even $$セントラル・ベース$$ on the South American front would fall, though...」

610:t_1:63.en:
$$尸刻$$
「An advance driven by emotion... That comes from the ignorance of not knowing the power of the $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_1:64.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm not sure you can say that... At the very least, they know we're the enemy who conquered their own planet in no time.」

610:t_1:65.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Just as 100 G and 1,000,000 G are both a huge sum to a child, they must understand that the $$サイデリアル$$ is a formidable enemy.」

610:t_1:67.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It has to be the special nature of the Earthling species.」

610:t_1:69.en:
$$尸刻$$
「An unyielding spirit that never gives up... A heart that trusts comrades and friends... A will to head into the future together with hope...」

610:t_1:70.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... of course they get marked. Anyone carrying stuff like that would.」

610:t_1:71.en:
$$尸刻$$
「And at the center of it all is $c...」

610:t_1:72.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「In other words, if we defeat that lot, we can hold the Earthlings down both militarily and spiritually. Simple and clear.」

610:t_1:73.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Either way, this planet really is special. I wonder what will become of it from here on...」

610:t_1:74.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Once the $$オリジン・ロー$$ extraction system is complete and the collection of spirit quanta is finished, this planet's people will be erased as a dangerous species.」

610:t_1:75.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「In short, the same fate as the planet $$ジェミナイ$$.」

610:t_1:76.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then the warriors worth watching... in other words, $c will be incorporated into the $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_1:77.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Just like 《$$ハイアデス$$》 and 《$$鬼宿$$》.」

610:t_1:78.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That's a loaded way to put it.」

610:t_1:79.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Since we're here anyway, let me hear it - the true feelings of $$ハイアデス$$.」

610:t_1:80.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I simply race across exhilarating battlefields together with Lady $$エルーナ$$.」

610:t_1:81.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ provides me that opportunity. That's all there is to it.」

610:t_1:82.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「For that, you'd have no complaint even if the previous chief was killed?」

610:t_1:83.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...Everything was decided by Lady $$エルーナ$$.」

610:t_1:84.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... Supreme Commander $$エルーナルーナ$$ is the previous chief's only daughter, after all. If she says OK, that's the end of it.」

610:t_1:85.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「What about your case, $$尸刻$$?」
